mentions.name: Marks out of Tenancy
mentions.description: The UK's largest and most active landlord review platform. It aggregates, hosts, and queries tenancy review data, with systems for estimating how many people live in a property, checking for HMO licensing to detect illegal or rogue landlords and illegal short lets, and longitudinal data collection on tenant-landlord housing conflict that informed the increase of the rent repayment order threshold in the renters rights act.
